app_title: Dr.D — Live Queue & AI Doctor Platform
theme: light with deep Dr.D blue (#1E3A8A) and Dai mint/green (#34D399) accents

visual_enhancers.card_style: rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm p-6

accessibility.aria_support: full aria attributes and keyboard navigation
accessibility.contrast_ratio: meets WCAG AA standards (>4.5:1 for normal text)

image_urls.description: Professional doctor portrait in white scrub suit

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive web application for Dr.D supporting Patients and Doctors.
Implement patient queue discovery, live position tracking, ETA calculation (doctor-set consult time), symptoms reason, and reschedule/cancel.
Implement doctor queue dashboard, manual Next / Done / No-show controls, daily queue caps, and Dai patient briefs.
Implement Dai AI assistant using Gemini 3 Flash for patient logs, logistics triage Q&A (no medical diagnosis).
Implement browser notifications and in-app live alerts for 15-min warning and 'you're next'.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use Dr.D blue (#1E3A8A) and Dai green/mint (#34D399) palette with clean Tailwind CSS and JS.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Never use full-screen gradients or transparent headers without blur.
Every interactive element must have hover states and data-testid attributes.
Avoid generic inter for headings; use Plus Jakarta Sans.
Ensure all forms use accessible Shadcn components where applicable.
